title: VUI LONG TAI BAN MOI NHAT
message: Ban moi da fix loi key het han van con ket trong app, dong thoi them TAM AO NEW va lam tam mong hon. Neu may mo duoc link thi bam nut ben duoi, khong thi len bio lay ban moi nhat.
hint: Neu may khong tai thang duoc, app se mo link bio de lay ban APK moi nhat.
